facts.fact: The EDPA notice states that section 5 of the Data Protection Act 2022 designates the Eswatini Communications Commission as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority, and the Authority itself issued the notice in June 2024.
The EDPA notice applies the Eswatini Data Protection Act 2022 in a June 2024 enforcement decision under its section 41, showing the Act in force.

The Eswatini Data Protection Authority issued Enforcement Notice 4/2024 under section 41(1)(a) of the Act in June 2024, imposing a warning on Liberty Life Swaziland Limited for breaching sections 14(1)(b) and 14(2) after a misdirected email exposed personal data of about 4,000 members.
